newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-SFE wheat futures edge up on grower trades.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-SFE wheat futures edge up on grower trades.

text.p: Sydney Futures Exchange wheat traded mostly slightly higher on Tuesday with two contracts selling in a total volume of four lots.

July 1997 rose by 50 cents to A$180.00 a tonne on two lots sold while January 1998 fell by A$2.00 a tonne to A$166.00 a tonne. Settlement prices for nearer-term contracts mostly moved ahead while more distant contracts edged back.
One broker said the trades involved hedging by growers to protect prices while the merchant trade remained absent. January 1998 represented a reasonably good price for growers, he said.
